Overview.Name: Nuvvula Laxmi
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_2 (Dinner - lighter): Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & egg omelette (2–3 eggs ~120 g total)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (120 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid fried and oily foods to support fatty liver recovery.
Start meals with protein before eating rice to improve metabolism.
Keep meals simple and home-cooked for better consistency.
Walking daily will help improve liver health and fat loss.
During social gatherings, eat your regular meal first before outside food.
